achievements.label: The Fall of the Iron Eater
achievements.descriptionLocked: Your arch enemy has unhorsed an Edge Long.
achievements.unlockMessage: 'Your arch enemy has unhorsed an Edge Long.' [In a duel, Von Helling defeated the Iron Eater.]

achievements.label: The Lion-Rat Duel
achievements.descriptionLocked: Your arch enemy has been through a lion-rat duel.
achievements.unlockMessage: 'Your arch enemy has been through a lion-rat duel.' [Together with a continental enemy, you assaulted Von Helling.]

achievements.label: The arch enemy Vanquished
achievements.descriptionLocked: You have overcome your arch enemy in a Strife.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: You have overcome your arch enemy in a Strife.
achievements.unlockMessage: 'You have overcome your arch enemy in a Strife.' [You have defeated Von Helling.]

achievements.label: "I" no longer exists; henceforth, only "We".
achievements.unlockMessage: "I" no longer exists; henceforth, only "We". [In Stalingrad, you and Ilsa von Helling become twin blades facing each other in a grand duel]

achievements.label: Old Spring Days
achievements.descriptionLocked: After the war, I will wait for which will never return.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: After the war, I will wait for which will never return.
achievements.unlockMessage: After the war, I will wait for which will never return. [In Stalingrad, you killed Ilsa von Helling in a duel. Your achievements allow you to do whatever you desire.]

achievements.label: The Accused
achievements.descriptionLocked: The snow is merciless, falling without a sound...
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: The snow is merciless, falling without a sound...
achievements.unlockMessage: The snow is merciless, falling without a sound... [In Stalingrad, you killed Ilsa von Helling with your own hands. You are arrested by the KGB and imprisoned; everything about you is forgotten.]

achievements.label: Victory and Survival
achievements.descriptionLocked: Those who live by war, those who feed to the war, those who devoured by the war.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: Those who live by war, those who feed to the war, those who devoured by the war.
achievements.unlockMessage: Those who live by war, those who feed to the war, those who devoured by the war. [In Stalingrad, you killed Ilsa von Helling with your own hands. You find that you can no longer leave the battlefield.]

achievements.label: Martyr of the Contest
achievements.descriptionLocked: When I fell on the snow, was there any sound?
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: When I fell on the snow, was there any sound?
achievements.unlockMessage: When I fell on the snow, was there any sound? [You were killed by Ilsa von Helling in a duel.]

achievements.label: The Story of the Mole
achievements.descriptionLocked: The Velvet keeps all secrets, I only care about mine.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: The Velvet keeps all secrets, I only care about mine.
achievements.unlockMessage: The Velvet keeps all secrets, I only care about mine. [Destroy the intelligence agency before the 'Gestapo' leaves]

achievements.label: Might of Svarog
achievements.descriptionLocked: Human cannot conquer the sky; I merely ensure the sky does not conquer us.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: Human cannot conquer the sky; I merely ensure the sky does not conquer us.
achievements.unlockMessage: Human cannot conquer the sky; I merely ensure the sky does not conquer us. [Initiate and win an air battle using a 'Fighter Aircraft']

achievements.label: The Sublime and the Terror
achievements.descriptionLocked: Once, humans trembled at the might of nature; today, the enemy quakes under our artillery fire.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: Once, humans trembled at the might of nature; today, the enemy quakes under our artillery fire.
achievements.unlockMessage: Once, humans trembled at the might of nature; today, the enemy quakes under our artillery fire. [Launch an offensive tactic and succeed]

achievements.label: Is That You, Virgil?
achievements.descriptionLocked: From there we went out, and beheld the brilliant stars again.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: From there we went out, and beheld the brilliant stars again.
achievements.unlockMessage: From there we went out, and beheld the brilliant stars again. [While the city is encircled, complete the 'Breakout' mission and successfully leave the theater of operations]

achievements.label: "Byronic"
achievements.descriptionLocked: "Must you fall with every ear of wheat?"
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: Must you fall with every ear of wheat?"
achievements.unlockMessage: Must you fall with every ear of wheat?" [Make the enemy's 'Infiltration', 'Decryption', and 'Resistance' all reach level 10 or higher simultaneously]

achievements.label: Sky, Steel, Dust
achievements.descriptionLocked: The touch of the aircraft swarm is as light as law, as heavy as heavenly fire.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: The touch of the aircraft swarm is as light as law, as heavy as heavenly fire.
achievements.unlockMessage: The touch of the aircraft swarm is as light as law, as heavy as heavenly fire. [Trigger an overwhelming aerial assault]

achievements.label: Skipping Stones
achievements.descriptionLocked: The lake in the woods rarely has visitors; a pebble leaps from the shore, skimming the water, and the lake does not refuse this visit.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: The lake in the woods rarely has visitors; a pebble leaps from the shore, skimming the water, and the lake does not refuse this visit.
achievements.unlockMessage: The lake in the woods rarely has visitors; a pebble leaps from the shore, skimming the water, and the lake does not refuse this visit. [Bring 'Galinka' into the 'Unseen Lake']

achievements.label: Gravity
achievements.descriptionLocked: In my name, I summon the fall.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: In my name, I summon the fall.
achievements.unlockMessage: In my name, I summon the fall. [Use an anti-aircraft 'AA Position' to shoot down an 'Enemy Fighter']

achievements.label: Not Gomorrah
achievements.descriptionLocked: Heavenly fire descended, but no one turned into a pillar of salt.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: Heavenly fire descended, but no one turned into a pillar of salt.
achievements.unlockMessage: Heavenly fire descended, but no one turned into a pillar of salt. [Let the enemy successfully execute a 'Bombing' mission]

achievements.label: Funeral of the Dead
achievements.descriptionLocked: I come from Lithuania, a true German.
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: I come from Lithuania, a true German.
achievements.unlockMessage: I come from Lithuania, a true German. [Due to a massive early-game advantage accumulated by the enemy, the enemy intelligence agency chooses to continue 'conducting operations']

achievements.label: "Air-Land Concerto"
achievements.descriptionLocked: "Replacing the brass with dive bombers in the fourth movement was extremely bold; the critics were instantly annihilated."
achievements.descriptionUnlocked: "Replacing the brass with dive bombers in the fourth movement was extremely bold; the critics were instantly annihilated."
achievements.unlockMessage: "Replacing the brass with dive bombers in the fourth movement was extremely bold; the critics were instantly annihilated." [After 'Sea Bell' launches 'Firepower Barrage', an enemy air force officer is present and uses aircraft to provide cover and intelligence bonuses for it]
